summary: Purvah Green Power extends the timeline for its ₹4,859 crore acquisition of 1.4 GWp renewable assets from ReNew Solar Power to November 21, 2026.

headline: Kalind Ltd approves acquisition of gems subsidiary
summary: Kalind Ltd board approved acquiring Kalind Gems & Diamonds Ltd as a wholly owned subsidiary for ₹1 crore. The move facilitates entry into the gems sector, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: NHPC Ltd ED Vivek Dwivedi to retire Oct 2026
summary: NHPC Limited announced the cessation of Executive Director Vivek Dwivedi upon superannuation. The change is effective October 31, 2026, as per SEBI disclosure norms.

headline: Confidence Futuristic Energetech Q2FY27 Results
summary: Confidence Futuristic Energetech Ltd reported consolidated net profit of ₹123.02 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹18.83 lakh in Q2FY26. Standalone revenue stood at ₹152.61 lakh.

headline: Quint Digital shareholders approve nine resolutions via postal ballot
summary: Quint Digital Limited members approved all nine resolutions, including asset encumbrance and related party transactions, with over 99% support.

headline: Shree Ajit Pulp installs 17 MW solar plants
summary: Shree Ajit Pulp and Paper Ltd plans to install 17 MW of solar capacity at its Valsad units for ₹62 crore, aiming to cut electricity costs via captive power.
